_comment: Regression test for rolldown/rolldown#10543: the `styles` entry re-exports bindings owned by the ESM-wrapped `w.js` (wrapping propagates from `lab.cjs` requiring `top.js`), `icon` pulls `w.js` into a wider shared chunk than the re-export barrels', and the barrels' forwarding statements are all tree-shaken (declared side-effect-free, like the `sideEffects: false` packages in the original report, while `w.js` carries a real side effect). No included statement owns `w.js`'s init, so the entry must call the cross-chunk `init_w` itself — and, per ESM evaluation order, before its own body: the entry body's probe observes `w.js`'s side effect.
